review_method: Viewed side-by-side 360x270 downsample per castle as phone-card proxy
Read completed terrain-fix Blender log and assembly reports
observations: Both castle silhouettes remain distinct at 360px width: stepped blue friendly keep versus tall red enemy spire.
Gate arch opening and bridge approach remain legible at phone-card size.
Seven hex terrain tiles now meet continuously; former triangular courtyard holes are gone. Narrow intentional cap-edge seams remain.
No cropped towers, flags or terrain perimeter in either image.
Walls meet corner towers visually; bridge enters the gate and courtyard paving is visible through the passage.
limitations: Static visual presentation pass only; no collision, navmesh, walk-through or gameplay test.
Phone proxy is a resized rendered image, not an actual device/browser test.
Small masonry marks and stair rails lose detail at phone size as expected.
Internal back-facing surfaces and concealed intersections were not exhaustively inspected.
